json.description: Floating call-to-action pill (bottom-right on desktop, full-width bar on mobile). Reveals after the visitor scrolls past part of the first viewport. Per-session dismissable.

hint.description: Sub-label shown under the primary label on desktop.

showOnPaths.description: If non-empty, the CTA only appears on these exact paths. Empty = every page (subject to hideOnPaths).

hideOnPaths.description: Paths to suppress on (typically the destination itself).

revealAfterRatio.description: Reveal once scrollY exceeds this fraction of viewport height.

revealAfterMin.description: Minimum scroll (px) before revealing, regardless of viewport ratio.

dismissable.description: Show the small × dismiss button (per-session sessionStorage).
